props.caption: CFB Wainwright. Four Canadian service members died during live-fire training; the fire’s cause remains under investigation.
Strait of Hormuz. Iran says two crude tankers caught fire after striking naval mines.
Near Vilnius. Authorities say security prevented a fire at a Starlink-equipment facility.

lead.what: Four Canadian service members died during live-fire training at CFB Wainwright; the fire’s cause remains under investigation.

rest.what: Lithuanian authorities say security prevented a fire at Starlink equipment near Vilnius and opened a pre-trial investigation.

lead.what: Question 10 asks whether Alberta should remain in Canada or begin the legal process for a binding referendum.

rest.what: Macron said prefects could ban certain gatherings and the prime minister would chair a crisis cell on 19 October.

lead.what: Iran says two crude tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
